names.details: Nehrü’l-Kurr: There are two rivers in this name. Yet, one of them is famous and the other is not mentioned as often. The more famous and greater one flows like a boundary between Āzerbaycān (Azerbaijan) and Errān (Arran). The water of this river is quite abundant and fresh. Its source is a mountain near Demirkapı, from which it emerges and flows through the lands of Errān (Arran), eventually emptying into the Baḥr-i Ḫazar (Caspian Sea)...
